newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's Tuntex trims 1996 profit target.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Tuntex trims 1996 profit target.

text.p: Taiwan's Tuntex Distinct Corp said on Tuesday it has cut its 1996 pre-tax profit target to T$1.12 billion from T$1.55 billion.
Tuntex, a chemical fibre and construction firm, also cut its 1996 sales target to T$16.71 billion from T$20.61 billion, the company said in a statement.
It was the second time in 1996 that Tuntex has cut its earning targets.
In august, it lowered pre-tax profit target to T$1.55 billion after reporting a first-half loss of T$712 million.
For the first ninth months of 1996, the company posted a T$281 million pre-tax loss on sales of T$9.358 billion
A company spokesman attributed the loss to falling prices for polyester fibre in 1996 and to a poor construction sector.
